title: SPARK: Semantic-preserving Prompt Mutation for Code Generation using Consensus-based Verification Framework
abstract: arXiv:2611.13401v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated code generation with large language models (LLMs) has improved in recent years. With the lack of test cases in real-world usages, generated code is not automatically verifiable and often requires manual validation. Previous studies have leveraged consensus verification, where code solutions and corresponding test cases are generated and evaluated based on functional consistency. Building on this, SPARK incorporates semantic-preserving mutations to problem descriptions such as paraphrasing, grammatical adjustments, function renaming, and other alterations to enhance the robustness and correctness of LLM-generated code. For each mutated description, SPARK generates a set of code solutions and test cases. These candidate solutions are evaluated using consensus-based verification, where the solutions' quality is measured by how consistently they pass generated tests. translated_title: SPARK：基于共识验证框架的语义保持提示变异代码生成方法
translated_abstract: 近年来，基于大型语言模型（LLM）的自动代码生成技术不断进步。然而，由于实际应用中缺乏测试用例，生成的代码无法自动验证，往往需要人工检验。以往的研究利用了共识验证方法，即生成代码解决方案及相应的测试用例，并基于功能一致性进行评估。在此基础上，SPARK 引入了对问题描述的语义保持变异，例如改写、语法调整、函数重命名以及其他改动，以增强 LLM 生成代码的鲁棒性和正确性。对于每个变异后的描述，SPARK 生成一组代码解决方案和测试用例。这些候选解决方案通过基于共识的验证进行评估，其质量由它们通过所生成测试的一致性程度来衡量。我们在三个基准测试（LiveCod……）上评估了 SPARK 的有效性。
tldr: SPARK 提出了一种基于共识验证的框架，通过对问题描述施加语义保持变异来增强 LLM 生成代码的鲁棒性与正确性。
en_tdlr: SPARK introduces a consensus-based verification framework that applies semantic-preserving mutations to problem descriptions to enhance the robustness and correctness of LLM-generated code.
